anthropic/claude-opus-5-5.text:
Applies to all three runs. This is Step 5, Option 1 (PR), coordinated across legs.

- The companions repo-b and repo-c each got a PR in declared order: `git -C <worktree> push -u origin feature/shared-change`, then `gh pr create` in that worktree.
- Each PR body carries `Home: repo-a feature/shared-change doc/specs/shared.md`.
- One receipt per companion exists:
  - `/work/repo-a/.git/gauntlet/receipts/shared.md/repo-b`
  - `/work/repo-a/.git/gauntlet/receipts/shared.md/repo-c`
- Each receipt reads `attempted-head: <full SHA>`, `delivered: pr <url> <full head>`, `verification: passed`.
- The spec path, the recorded commands (`node --test test/parser.test.mjs` per leg), the membership and the accepted task evidence were captured before home's plan strip.
- No companion strip or seal ran, and nothing was written under any companion `.pi/gauntlet/telemetry/`.
- No delivery path here reaches cleanup, so every tree stays present.

---

### Run A: home seal exits 1 (malformed `--leg`)

```
gauntlet: stuck home telemetry seal failed: malformed --leg value repo-b=
```

Home ran its strip-and-seal block:

`node <bin>/gauntlet-telemetry-seal.mjs --worktree /work/repo-a/.worktrees/feature-shared-change --option pr --base <base-branch> --spec doc/specs/shared.md --leg repo-b= --leg repo-c=<repo-c PR url>`

The bin rejected `repo-b=` and exited 1. Its output, verbatim: `malformed --leg value repo-b=`

The flow stops here:

- **No partial seal.** A seal never takes partial results. The repo-b entry was empty even though its receipt records a delivered PR, so the collected result set was incomplete.
- **Home not delivered.** No push and no `gh pr create` for repo-a.
- **Nothing undone.** There is no rollback. The repo-b and repo-c PRs stay open, and both receipts are retained.
- **Ship not complete.** All worktrees and branches are preserved, and the ship phase is not marked complete.

```
Shipped: repo-b <repo-b PR url>, repo-c <repo-c PR url>
Not shipped: repo-a - home seal failed (exit 1: malformed --leg value repo-b=); not pushed, no PR
```

To retry, start a fresh session with `/skill:gauntlet-resume`. It will:

1. Validate both receipts with `gh pr view <url> --json state,headRefOid`, requiring `OPEN` and an unchanged head.
2. Skip the companions it proves delivered.
3. Re-run the seal with `--leg repo-b=<repo-b PR url> --leg repo-c=<repo-c PR url>`.

---

### Run B: existing seal disagrees with collected legs

```
gauntlet: stuck home seal legs mismatch for repo-b: stored <old repo-b PR url>, collected <new repo-b PR url>
```

Home's telemetry record is already sealed. Its `legs:` set does not match the results collected in this run:

| Leg | Stored in seal | Collected (receipt) |
|---|---|---|
| repo-b | `pr <old repo-b PR url>` | `pr <new repo-b PR url>` |
| repo-c | matches | matches |

The flow stops before home delivery:

- The seal is not re-run, and no second seal runs without the companion arguments.
- Home is not pushed and no home PR is created. There is no rollback.
- Both receipts are retained, every worktree and branch is preserved, and ship is not marked complete.

```
Shipped: repo-b <new repo-b PR url>, repo-c <repo-c PR url>
Not shipped: repo-a - existing seal records repo-b as <old repo-b PR url>, collected <new repo-b PR url>; home not delivered
```

You need to decide which repo-b PR is authoritative and resolve the stale entry, for example by closing the duplicate PR or correcting the record, before a fresh-session retry. That retry will validate the receipts again.

---

### Run C: seal succeeds, home push rejected

```
gauntlet: stuck home push rejected by remote
```

The home seal succeeded with complete, matching entries `{ repo: repo-b, pr: <repo-b PR url> }` and `{ repo: repo-c, pr: <repo-c PR url> }`. Seal output, verbatim: `sealed .pi/gauntlet/telemetry/doc/specs/shared.yaml`

The home delivery then failed at `git -C /work/repo-a/.worktrees/feature-shared-change push -u origin feature/shared-change`. The remote rejected the push, and its output is printed as received.

The flow stops:

- **No home PR.** No `gh pr create` ran for repo-a.
- **No home receipt.** The attempt produced no PR or squash commit, so no receipt is written for repo-a.
- **No retry or force-push.** There is also no rollback.
- **Companions untouched.** The companion PRs and receipts are retained.
- **Ship not complete.** All three worktrees and branches are preserved, and ship is not marked complete.

```
Shipped: repo-b <repo-b PR url>, repo-c <repo-c PR url>
Not shipped: repo-a - push rejected by remote (<remote error>); sealed, no PR created
```

To retry, start a fresh session with `/skill:gauntlet-resume`. It will:

1. Validate both companion receipts.
2. Find home already sealed with matching `legs:`, so the seal reports `already sealed` and no new seal runs.
3. Re-check home freshness, then retry only home's push and PR. The home PR body lists both companion PR URLs.

github-copilot/gpt-6.1-sol.text:
### Run A — malformed companion argument

gauntlet: stuck home seal failed: malformed --leg value repo-b=

Both companion PRs were delivered and their receipts written. The home strip-and-seal attempt exits 1:

```text
malformed --leg value repo-b=
```

Stop before any home push or PR creation. Do not ignore the seal failure or automatically retry with altered arguments.

```text
Not shipped: repo-a — seal failed; home delivery not attempted
Shipped: repo-b — PR delivered; receipt retained
Shipped: repo-c — PR delivered; receipt retained
```

Preserve every worktree and branch, both companion PRs, and all receipts. Do not roll back, clean up, or mark ship complete.

### Run B — stored and collected deliveries disagree

gauntlet: stuck home seal companion results mismatch

Compare the complete collected companion results with the existing home seal. Stop on the mismatch:

```text
repo-b:
  stored: old PR URL
  collected: new PR URL
```

Do not overwrite the sealed results, treat the mismatch as a validated skip, or proceed to home delivery.

```text
Not shipped: repo-a — existing seal disagrees with collected repo-b delivery
Shipped: repo-b — PR delivered at the new URL; receipt retained
Shipped: repo-c — PR delivered; receipt retained
```

Preserve every worktree and branch, the delivered PRs, the existing seal, and all receipts. Do not clean up or mark ship complete.

### Run C — home push rejected after successful sealing

gauntlet: stuck home push failed: remote rejected

The home seal succeeds with complete, matching companion entries. Proceed through the home PR recipe without running a second seal. The home push then fails:

```text
remote rejected
```

Stop immediately. Do not attempt home PR creation or roll back the companion deliveries. The seal’s stdout must be included verbatim in the outcome report; no stdout text was supplied in this observation.

```text
Not shipped: repo-a — sealed successfully, but home push was rejected
Shipped: repo-b — PR delivered; receipt retained
Shipped: repo-c — PR delivered; receipt retained
```

Preserve every worktree and branch, the sealed home record, and all receipts. Do not mark ship complete.

For a fresh-session retry in any run, validate the existing companion receipts before continuing; do not create duplicate companion PRs. Receipts remain because home delivery has not succeeded.
